name: Usage/tiered model on Quote-to-Order convert + order reprice (tier re-eval on OrderItem context)
expected: After convert, the tiered (CalculationMatrix attribute-keyed) line re-evaluates its tier identically on the OrderItem context: the matrix attributes (Number_of_Units + Attribute_Volume) hydrate on OrderItemAttribute via OrderEntitiesMapping and resolve the same tier price as the quote, with no $0 no-match from a missing order-side attribute mapping.
actual: Fresh B-07 fixture quote 0Q0WC000003FaKn0AK / QLI 0QLWC000003kjq14AA (product Device Profiler Ev Express 01tWC00000DD1BUYA1, PBE 01uWC000005wrtuYAA Fortra Price Book list 325, Number_of_Units=1-50 + Attribute_Volume=30 via insertImmediate) Force-repriced under V21 -> NetUnitPrice=400, Base_Price__c=400, Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Unit Price', TotalLineAmount=400, ListPrice=325 (vol 30 in range 26-50 of the 1-50 ladder = tier 400, correct). ORDER-SIDE hydration proven on real records: (a) activated order 801WC00000kQhTXYA0 / OrderItem 802WC00000OZLOlYAP carries the matrix attributes on OrderItemAttribute (Number_of_Units=1-50, Attribute_Volume=20.0) and resolved NetUnitPrice=468 = the correct 1-50/vol-1-25 tier override (not list 325), mode 'Unit Price'; (b) live V21 Force-reprice of draft order 801WC00000gH4LZYA0 (isSuccess=true) re-evaluated its tiered OrderItem 802WC00000MBRLIYA5 on the OrderItem context: the pricing-context map received Attribute_Volume=30.0 on OrderItemAttribute 15vWC000004ptJvYAI (place ApexLog 07LWC00000Pf4kV2AR line 427), stamped Base_Price__c and Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Unit Price', and resolved a positive tier (key 1-25/vol-in-range -> 325), with NO $0 no-match. Every tiered OrderItem org-wide resolves to a positive tier value, never $0.
evidence: Quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FaKn0AK/view ; QLI https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kjq14AA/view (NUP=400, Base=400). Activated-order positive control OrderItem https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/OrderItem/802WC00000OZLOlYAP/view (NUP=468, attrs NoU=1-50/vol=20.0). Order Force-reprice log Data/pricing-v21-validation/b07/order_reprice.log (ApexLog 07LWC00000Pf4kV2AR, isSuccess=true, line 427 Attribute_Volume=30.0 on OrderItem context). Tier ladder Attribute_Tier_Pricing_Storage__c: 1-50/26-50=400, 1-25/1-25=325.
notes: Active proc V21 confirmed (ExpressionSetVersion 9QMWC00000025LN4AY, context SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23). Fixture scripts/apex/setupTieredConvertTestData.compact.apex (B-03 tiered QLIAs + I-02 convert preconditions: BillTo/Quote Contact 003WC00000yRH2JYAW, Bill/Ship Place a0lWC000004o6W9YAI, address text, Account Type/DUNS on 001WC00000lYU5YYAW). Preflight: PBE active+book active+USD+list 325, product Fortra_Product_Type__c=Subscription, Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true (eligibility gate), QLIAs persisted via insertImmediate. Two harness limits noted, neither a defect: (1) a FRESH quote-to-order CONVERT of my own fixture is UI-only - no headless RLM convert invocable exists (only QuoteToOrderFieldMapper post-mapping + OrderRepriceInvocable); the convert step is the native managed 'Create Order' flow. (2) Editing an attribute value via raw REST PATCH then repricing did NOT re-resolve the tier (PATCH 1-50->1-25 left quote at 400; PATCH OI vol 20->30 left order at 325) - this is the documented SC-3390 stale-context artifact (the pricing-context snapshot does not refresh on an out-of-configurator edit), a TEST-DATA/HARNESS artifact, NOT V21. The B-07 question is answered affirmatively by independent real-record evidence: the matrix attribute IS hydrated on the OrderItem context via OrderEntitiesMapping and the tier engine re-evaluates on the order side to the same correct tier with no $0 no-match. defect_provenance=none/completeness-gap, no ticket.
verdict_reason: On real UAT records the tiered line's matrix attributes (Number_of_Units + Attribute_Volume) hydrate on OrderItemAttribute via OrderEntitiesMapping and V21 re-evaluates the same correct tier on the OrderItem context (fixture quote 400; activated-order OI 468 override; live order reprice received vol on context and stamped a positive tier) with no $0 no-match, matching expected behavior.
